The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is seeking an Integrations Engineer, Enterprise Systems to build and maintain the integrations that connect our core business systems. You will design, implement, test, and monitor workflows across systems such as Salesforce, CPQ, NetSuite, Workday, Marketo, Snowflake, and iPaaS platforms, with a focus on data quality, operational reliability, and business impact. You will partner closely with Finance Systems, GTM Systems, People Ops, RevOps, and IT stakeholders to translate business requirements into durable technical solutions. You should be comfortable working hands-on with APIs, scripts, data transformations, error handling, and integration monitoring while communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical partners. This is the third Integrations Engineer hire, and you will work closely with Sriharsha Gurram, the Lead Integrations Engineer, to develop the foundations and architecture of the integrations function.

This is a builder role for someone who enjoys making business-critical systems more reliable, scalable, and understandable. The ideal candidate has enough technical depth to debug integration failures and write scripts, enough systems judgment to avoid creating long-term tech debt, and enough stakeholder empathy to help teams make tradeoffs when speed, accuracy, and scalability compete.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain integrations between core enterprise systems including Salesforce, CPQ, NetSuite, Workday, Marketo, Snowflake, and related business applications.

  • Develop data pipelines, workflow automations, and reverse ETL-style syncs that help GTM, Finance, People Ops, and other teams operate from trusted data.

  • Translate business requirements into integration designs, data mappings, and implementation plans that are scalable, observable, and maintainable.

  • Troubleshoot data sync issues, schema mismatches, API failures, and workflow exceptions across multiple systems.

  • Implement strong error handling, logging, alerting, validation, rollback, and documentation practices for business-critical workflows.

  • Partner with Finance Systems and GTM Systems stakeholders on Lead-to-Cash, Quote-to-Cash, order management, billing, and reporting workflows.

  • Partner with People Ops and IT stakeholders on employee lifecycle and identity-adjacent workflows where enterprise systems need accurate, automated data movement.

  • Document integration designs, dependencies, runbooks, and operational procedures so the team can scale beyond heroics and single-owner knowledge.

  • Support integration platform standards for API usage, data modeling, monitoring, and production readiness under the guidance of the Lead Integration Engineer or hiring manager.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain integrations between core enterprise systems including Salesforce, CPQ, NetSuite, Workday, Marketo, Snowflake, and related business applications.

  • Develop data pipelines, workflow automations, and reverse ETL-style syncs that help GTM, Finance, People Ops, and other teams operate from trusted data.

  • Translate business requirements into integration designs, data mappings, and implementation plans that are scalable, observable, and maintainable.

  • Troubleshoot data sync issues, schema mismatches, API failures, and workflow exceptions across multiple systems.

  • Implement strong error handling, logging, alerting, validation, rollback, and documentation practices for business-critical workflows.

  • Partner with Finance Systems and GTM Systems stakeholders on Lead-to-Cash, Quote-to-Cash, order management, billing, and reporting workflows.

  • Partner with People Ops and IT stakeholders on employee lifecycle and identity-adjacent workflows where enterprise systems need accurate, automated data movement.

  • Document integration designs, dependencies, runbooks, and operational procedures so the team can scale beyond heroics and single-owner knowledge.

  • Support integration platform standards for API usage, data modeling, monitoring, and production readiness under the guidance of the Lead Integration Engineer or hiring manager.

 

What You Have

  • You have 3–5+ years of experience in integration engineering, software engineering, business systems engineering, or a related backend systems role.

  • You have hands-on experience working within an iPaaS platform (e.g. Workato) to build or maintain integrations across enterprise SaaS systems, ideally including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, Ashby, Marketo, Snowflake, or comparable platforms.

  • You understand modern API patterns and authentication concepts, including REST, SOAP, GraphQL, OAuth, SAML, SCIM, and related integration standards.

  • You can write scripts in Python, JavaScript, or a similar language to handle transformations, validation, orchestration, or automation logic.

  • You have strong troubleshooting instincts and can work systematically through logs, data mismatches, failed syncs, and edge cases.

  • You know how to communicate tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders and can push back when a requested solution would create fragility, governance issues, or unnecessary tech debt.

  • You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where requirements may be ambiguous, priorities may shift, and systems may still be maturing.

  • You have a bias toward pragmatic execution, but you also care about building repeatable patterns, documentation, and operational safeguards.

 

Bonus Points

  • Experience with reverse ETL concepts and data warehousing workflows is a plus.

  • Familiarity with Lead-to-Cash, Quote-to-Cash, CPQ, order management, billing, revenue recognition, or ERP workflows is a plus.

  • Experience in high-growth B2B SaaS, legal tech, enterprise AI, or other environments with complex cross-functional systems is a plus.

  • Exposure to identity lifecycle, provisioning, or access-related integrations is useful but not required.

Compensation

$133,500 - $200,300 USD

The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We are hiring a hands-on leader to own how Harvey designs its GTM incentive strategy for its go-to-market organization. As Head of GTM Incentive Strategy, you will design the incentive architecture that turns our revenue strategy into the plans, quotas, and payouts that motivate and reward our sellers. This is a design-first, high-ownership role: you will set the compensation philosophy, build the plans, and put the modeling and governance in place to keep them fair, motivating, and defensible as we scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end to end design of GTM incentive compensation across both pre- and post-sales organizations, including quota carrying AEs, sales leadership, solutions and overlay teams, customer success, etc.

  • Build the models that forecast plan cost, incentive ROI, and attainment distribution; run scenario analysis to stress-test designs before they ship and diagnose plans already in market

  • Partner with Compensation Business Partner to align OTE, pay mix, and leverage to market benchmarks and internal equity, and to keep plan spend inside budget

  • Set and communicate the compensation philosophy: produce executive-ready narratives on plan performance and risk, and educate GTM leaders and sellers so plans drive the behavior they are designed to reward

  • Architect plan mechanics that scale with hypergrowth, including quota structures, accelerators, multipliers, and SPIFFs

  • Translate GTM strategy changes - new segments, product and pricing launches, territory and coverage-model shifts - into comp plan updates delivered with speed and accuracy

  • Partner with compensation admin team on the ICM platform, quota-to-payout reconciliation, payout automation, and real-time earnings visibility for sellers and managers

  • Establish the governance layer - plan documentation, cross-functional approval workflows, version control, and audit-ready practices - and lead dispute resolution with clear SLAs and consistent outcomes

  • Partner with Finance on how goals translate to outcomes and the subsequent incentive strategy

What You Have

  • 10+ years in sales/incentive compensation design, revenue operations, or a closely related field, with demonstrated experience owning plan design at scale in a B2B SaaS environment

  • Deep, hands-on expertise designing incentive structures sales organizations - accelerators, SPIFFs, overlays, and co-sell frameworks

  • Strong analytical and modeling skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous questions, work with incomplete data, and quantify the cost and ROI of design decisions

  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, People, and Legal through clear communication, strong judgment, and data-backed recommendations

  • Comfort operating autonomously as a leader and function owner - setting direction and building the function directly, with or without a team beneath you

  • Bonus: experience in high-growth or hypergrowth organizations, with consumption- or usage-based pricing dynamics, or in AI / legal technology

Compensation

$212,000 - $318,000 USD

Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices here.
